title: Availability runtime block
description: The block an API response or artifact carries when a source is not fully available: `{state, reason, source, age, provenance}`. The state vocabulary (available, partial, stale, provider, training, missing) is ADR-0080 section 3's and is declared per boundary in the missing-data behavior column of the contract catalog (C22), with the test of each state; this contract keeps only the vocabulary and the block. `reason` is required for every state but available, `age` is an ISO 8601 duration and may be null only for available and missing, a provider answer names its provenance kind.

reason.description: A reason: a string, or an object with an 'en' string (bilingual products add 'es'); null only when available.

source.description: What answered: the real producer, a cached snapshot, the provider's path, a model version or the baseline.

age.description: An ISO 8601 duration, or null (allowed only for available and missing).

provenance.description: Required when state is provider: the kind of provider that answered (stub, simulator, fixture or baseline).

state.description: available, partial, stale, provider, training or missing (case-sensitive): the six states of the dimensioned contract-first method. A provider answer carries the provider kind as provenance.
